source: Founder Season One commission, Stuart Taylor, received 17 Nov 2026

stories.title: The Morning Hickory Hollow Woke Up Laughing
stories.brief: Mysterious chuckles echo through the Hollow one autumn morning. Each friend has a different theory. The search uncovers an amusing secret beneath Buck's porch. Season opener introducing all eleven naturally.
flags: ORIGINALITY: archived S01-001 also hinged on a discovery beneath Buck's porch (Bramble's drawings). The secret must be different in kind.
SHERLOCK: if the chuckle has a natural source, it must be accurate for autumn.
CROWDING: introducing eleven characters in one story needs a light, staggered structure.

stories.title: Benny and the Bridge That Wouldn't Behave
stories.brief: Benny's carefully calculated footbridge runs into unexpected problems. Barney's unconventional ideas frustrate him until combining both approaches gives a better solution.
flags: VARIETY: same 'careful Benny v. playful Barney' engine as 009 and 025. Each needs a distinct turn.
CANON: the Hollow's seven named bridges are old. Place the new footbridge over a side stream or ditch.
SAFEGUARDING: low crossing over shallow water, adult present for any cutting.
BRIEF GAP: Reba's role is undefined. Use her v1.1 curiosity, not v1.0 Rosie's inventor role (open decision).

stories.title: Maggie Mae's Magnificent Autumn Party
stories.brief: Maggie Mae plans an elegant autumn celebration. Charlie's eager help causes comic mishaps. Maggie Mae learns friendship matters more than flawless arrangements.
flags: VARIETY: 'well-meant help causes comic chaos at an event' also drives 018, 023 and 028, all featuring Maggie Mae. Space them out and vary the engine.

stories.title: Maverick and the Mystery of the Golden Feathers
stories.brief: Golden feathers appear along woodland paths. Maverick and Rusty's theories grow wilder until careful observation reveals the truth.
flags: SHERLOCK: plausible native source in autumn, e.g. northern flicker (yellow-shafted) or the American goldfinch's autumn moult. Verify before outlining.
PROHIBITION: the explanation must never imply predation. Feathers come from moulting only.

stories.title: Brody and the Very Small Hero
stories.moral: Everyone has something valuable to contribute
stories.brief: Brody believes strength makes him every adventure's hero. A much smaller friend succeeds where strength cannot.
flags: CANON: v1.1 Brody is warm and gentle. His overconfidence must stay kindly, never boastful or dismissive (012 already covers boasting).
CANON: Charlie is 'loving and inexperienced', not v1.0 Pip's 'small but mighty'. Her success should come from her own traits.

stories.title: Sadie Belle and the Secret of Silver Creek
stories.moral: Curiosity and patience reveal hidden wonders
stories.brief: An unusual arrangement of stones by Silver Creek leads Sadie Belle and Beau to a forgotten woodland tradition.
flags: CANON: must not be confused with v1.0's Story Stones (a ring in a fold of the hills). Archived S01-029 was 'Beau and the Story Stones'.
VARIETY: 'rediscovered forgotten tradition' also in 017 (old map) and 022. Differentiate.
CANON: Sadie Belle's crush on Beau stays innocent and largely unnoticed by him.

stories.title: Reba's Great Hickory Nut Mix-Up
stories.brief: Reba organises the nut harvest. Her shortcuts create a hilarious muddle, so she must own up and put it right with Barney.
flags: VARIETY: Reba's 'enthusiasm makes a mess; she makes amends' arc recurs in 023. Make 007 about organising and shortcuts, 023 about appetite and self-control.
CANON: shortcuts are v1.0 Finn/Rusty's signature. Make sure Reba's are her own.

stories.title: The Lanterns of Hickory Hollow
stories.brief: At autumn's close the friends make lanterns for what they are thankful for. One unexpected lantern becomes the most meaningful.
flags: FOUNDER: is the lantern custom new canon, or part of v1.0's Harvest Home 'going-round of thanks'? Recommend making it part of Harvest Home.
SAFEGUARDING: lit flames. Adults light and carry them, or use lanterns with no open flame for the children.
CANON: keep distinct from the winter Longest Night candles.

stories.title: Barney and the Snowflake Surprise
stories.brief: Barney's spectacular winter surprise fails. Benny helps him see small thoughtful gestures mean most.
flags: VARIETY: third Benny/Barney pairing. Here the roles reverse, which helps. Keep it.
OPTIONAL: no winter story uses v1.0's Longest Night, the franchise's most beloved festival. This or 014 could host it if wanted.

stories.title: The Night Maverick Couldn't See the Stars
stories.brief: Winter cloud hides the stars Maverick loves. He cannot lead a familiar evening tradition and learns from Buck when to wait and when to ask for help.
flags: SHERLOCK: bald eagles are daytime birds that roost at dusk. Keep him on the ground at night, star-watching from the porch rather than flying.
FOUNDER/CANON: the 'familiar evening tradition' Maverick guides is new and must be defined.

stories.title: Maggie Mae and the Mystery of the Missing Mittens
stories.moral: Never assume the worst about someone
stories.brief: Mittens go missing across the Hollow. Maggie Mae and Reba discover a touching explanation involving a neighbour quietly helping others.
flags: SAFEGUARDING/MORAL: the neighbour must not be modelled as taking things without asking. Recommended mechanism: the neighbour mends or knits from a lost-property basket, or the mittens were given freely.
CANON: Reba, the pantry investigator, as a suspect must be handled kindly or avoided.

stories.title: Beau's Big Winter Boast
stories.brief: Beau declares himself the finest winter sportsman. Comic failures teach him friendship and good sportsmanship beat winning.
flags: SAFEGUARDING: no skating on ice the children judge themselves. Only adult-designated ice, or snow sports on safe slopes.
SAFEGUARDING: comic falls stay soft and harmless.

stories.title: Charlie and the Quietest Day
stories.brief: Energetic Charlie struggles with a snowbound afternoon. Sadie Belle shows her the small wonders hidden in winter's stillness.
flags: SHERLOCK: real chipmunks are mostly dormant in winter. A light in-world line can explain Charlie being up and about.

stories.title: Great-Grandpappy Buck's Storytelling Challenge
stories.moral: Every voice deserves to be heard
stories.brief: Buck invites every friend to contribute a story to a winter gathering. Each struggles with self-doubt before finding their own voice.
flags: CROWDING: ten separate self-doubt arcs will not fit well in 5,500 words. Recommend three or four deep arcs, the rest light.
VARIETY: overlaps 024 (a storytelling game that spreads to the whole Hollow). Differentiate.

stories.title: Benny, Barney and the Frozen Waterwheel
stories.brief: The Old Mill's wheel stops in a cold spell. Working safely with experienced adults, the friends investigate and help find a practical solution.
flags: SAFEGUARDING: children stay away from the wheel, the millrace and ice. Adults handle all machinery and ice.
SHERLOCK: accurate mechanics (ice in the race and on the paddles, why the miller stops the wheel).

stories.title: Sadie Belle and the First Spring Flower
stories.brief: Sadie Belle hunts for the first spring flower to surprise Maggie Mae and learns to appreciate living things without disturbing them.
flags: SHERLOCK: earliest native candidates are hepatica, bloodroot and trailing arbutus.
CANON: avoid skunk cabbage, as Maggie Mae must never be linked to bad smells.
SUGGESTION: Maggie Mae is the gardener (v1.1), so give her that expertise.

stories.title: Rusty and the Map That Led Nowhere
stories.brief: Rusty finds an old map with curious symbols. A supervised expedition leads to unexpected discoveries.
flags: ORIGINALITY: archived S02-011 was 'Rusty's Map for the Brothers'. Keep the premise distinct.
VARIETY: another 'relic of the past' story alongside 006 and 022.
SAFEGUARDING: the supervising adult is named and present throughout.

stories.title: Charlie's Big-Sister Surprise
stories.moral: Thoughtful help starts with understanding another's needs
stories.brief: Charlie takes over Maggie Mae's responsibilities for a day. Comic confusion follows and she gains appreciation for all Maggie Mae does.
flags: VARIETY: second Charlie-causes-comic-chaos-for-Maggie-Mae story after 003. Recommend 018 focuses on Charlie's discovery of Maggie Mae's hidden, unseen work, not on mishaps.

stories.title: Brody and the Butterfly Garden
stories.brief: Brody plants for beauty, not usefulness. Reba helps him learn what butterflies and pollinators actually need.
flags: CANON: Maggie Mae, not Reba, is the gardener in v1.1. Recommend Reba learns by curious observation (watching which flowers are visited) rather than as the expert.
SHERLOCK: native nectar and host plants (milkweed, bee balm, asters, joe-pye weed), and caterpillars need host plants. Planting in spring with butterflies arriving later needs a realistic timescale.

stories.title: Maverick's Mountain Message
stories.brief: An important message must reach neighbours across the ridge before a celebration. Maverick learns reliable delivery needs planning, clarity and responsibility.
flags: CANON: the neighbours across the ridge are a new community. Founder confirmation needed if they are named.

stories.title: The Day Beau Became a Gentleman
stories.moral: Be yourself and treat others with consideration
stories.brief: Beau tries to become the most refined gentleman in the Hollow. Exaggerated manners cause hilarity until he finds genuine kindness more impressive.
flags: CANON CONFLICT (founder decision): the brief has Beau trying to impress Sadie Belle. Bible v1.1 says her innocent crush on him is 'largely unnoticed' by him. Recommended alternative: Beau wants to impress the whole Hollow, or learn from Maggie Mae, while Sadie Belle's quiet affection runs alongside, unnoticed by him.

stories.title: The Secret Garden of Hickory Hollow
stories.moral: Community cooperation and caring for shared places
stories.brief: An overgrown garden behind an old woodland cottage becomes a community restoration, revealing a forgotten tradition that brings generations together.
flags: TITLE: closely echoes Frances Hodgson Burnett's 'The Secret Garden' (public domain). Founder may prefer a more distinctive title.
MORAL/SAFEGUARDING: the cottage's ownership must be clear, so the restoration is by permission or of a shared place.
VARIETY: third 'forgotten tradition' story (006, 017).

stories.title: Reba and the Great Blackberry Disaster
stories.brief: Reba helps Maggie Mae make blackberry treats. Her appetite causes a sticky disaster needing honesty, patience and teamwork.
flags: VARIETY: see 007 and 003. Keep the appetite and self-control engine.
CANON: Blackberry Bank (v1.0); blackberries ripen mid-summer, which fits.

stories.title: Maverick and the Cloud Castle
stories.brief: Maverick and Charlie see shapes in summer clouds. Their game grows into a storytelling adventure for the whole Hollow.
flags: VARIETY: whole-Hollow storytelling overlaps 014.
SAFEGUARDING: Charlie must not ride on Maverick in flight unless the founder approves it, as it is an imitation risk.

stories.title: Benny's Impossible Invention
stories.moral: Practical wisdom and learning from failure
stories.brief: Benny's elaborate chore-saving invention grows ever more complicated. Barney helps him see simple solutions are often best.
flags: VARIETY: closest to 002 (Benny's plan versus Barney's insight). Recommend 025 lets Benny's own failed tests teach him, with Rusty's role meaningful.

stories.title: Brody and the Little Lost Melody
stories.moral: Patience and the joy of learning
stories.brief: Brody can't remember a melody Buck played. Their search becomes a gentle musical adventure about patience and treasured memories.
flags: ORIGINALITY: archived S01-025 was 'Brody's First Banjo Song'.
CANON: implies Buck is the banjo master and Brody the learner, which settles the earlier banjo question if confirmed.

stories.title: The Mystery of the Moonlit Meadow
stories.moral: Wonder, observation and respect for nature
stories.brief: Strange lights over Fern Meadow on a supervised summer evening lead to an extraordinary natural phenomenon.
flags: SHERLOCK (required before outline): recommended phenomenon is synchronous fireflies (Photinus carolinus), native to the Smokies. Peak display is roughly late May to mid-June.
CONFLICT: that timing suits early summer, so 027 may need to move nearer 023 or be set 'early summer'.
CONFLICT: displays are best on dark nights, so 'Moonlit' in the title fights the science (could be a thin moon).
ORIGINALITY: avoid foxfire (archived S01-004 'Hattie and the Foxfire').
CANON: ordinary fireflies are already nightly in v1.0, so the wonder must be the synchrony.

stories.title: Beau and the World's Worst Picnic
stories.brief: Beau's magnificent surprise picnic goes wrong in every way but becomes unexpectedly memorable.
flags: VARIETY: event-goes-wrong engine (003, 023); also echoes 009 (grand surprise fails). Differentiate, perhaps by making the failures external rather than Beau's fault.

stories.title: The Summer Everyone Helped
stories.secondary: Keeping cool; caring for the vulnerable
stories.brief: Unusual heat causes difficulties. The community protects vulnerable neighbours, shares resources and keeps everyone comfortable.
flags: SAFEGUARDING: heat stays an inconvenience, not a danger. No wildfire, no drought peril, no one becomes ill on the page.
CONTINUITY: the heatwave sets up 030 and v1.0's 'hottest day of a hot summer, Silver Creek running low' log origin.

stories.title: The Promise Beneath the Hickory Tree
stories.leads: Benny; Barney; Great-Grandpappy Buck; complete cast
stories.moral: Friendship, belonging and courage to embrace change
stories.brief: At the final summer gathering the friends reflect and make promises. Benny and Barney discover an opportunity hinting at a journey beyond the Hollow.
flags: FOUNDER DECISION REQUIRED BEFORE DRAFTING: the ending. Bible v1.0 Canon 5 has the hollow-log departure. Bible v1.1 says 'no destination, route, departure or River Rangers connection is established' and reserves it for Benny & Barney's Great Adventure.
SAFEGUARDING: v1.0's version has young beavers asleep in a drifting log on open water. Dr Noura would require careful handling to avoid an imitation risk.
SEASON TWO DEPENDENCY: if the brothers leave, Season Two must be planned around their absence or return.
